programme.desc: Marital Troubles. Amputee Cedric's happy marriage to Robin faces its biggest challenge. Squeaker tests people's patience and a wild penguin comes in with a life-threatening wound. S1, Ep5

programme.title: Meet The Penguins
programme.desc: Birthday Girl. A wild penguin receives treatment for a life-or-death wound. Two home-pen inhabitants get into a fight and one of the residents celebrates a special occasion. S1, Ep6

programme.title: Tanked
programme.desc: Rock N' Roll Eruption! Wayde and Brett put their creativity to the test when a client requests a playable 8-piece drum set. Plus, a bar wants a tank with a lava spewing volcano. S3, Ep14

programme.title: Animal Cops Houston
programme.desc: Snakes Alive. Snake fan and investigator Dana Almengor is called into action after a boa constrictor is found writhing around a site in Galveston. S11, Ep10

programme.title: Animal Cops San Francisco
programme.desc: Not-So-Abandoned-House. Scott rescues a dehydrated pit bull puppy that has been left, muzzled and chained, in the back of a hot car. Will its owners be allowed to redeem their dog? S6, Ep1

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins
programme.desc: Bindi's Croc Trip Surprise. The family return to the Steve Irwin Wildlife Rescue to study crocodiles. Then, Bindi and Chandler reveal an exciting, life-changing announcement. S3, Ep8

programme.title: Pit Bulls & Parolees
programme.desc: Boiling Point. As temperatures soar in New Orleans, so do tempers. Tia calls out the parolees on their laziness, leading to an explosive confrontation with new parolee Randy. S4, Ep8

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Porcupine Blind Date. The zoo opens an endangered turtle species facility, while Malayan tigers Suhanna and Rimba struggle to breed. And, needles the porcupine gets a new mate. S4, Ep13

programme.title: The Zoo
programme.desc: Penguins In Love. Seven charismatic penguins join the colony. Meanwhile, a grizzly bear has a serious foot injury and a turtle struggles to get along with the crocodiles. S4, Ep14

programme.title: Lone Star Law
programme.desc: Caught Red Handed. Texas Game Wardens go undercover to stop a black market for buying and selling wild animals - and one illegal seller goes wild when he gets caught. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet
programme.desc: Holiday Miracles. With the holidays approaching, the clinic is busier than ever. The team host a fundraiser, and Dr Jeff performs emergency surgery on a dog found tied to a fence. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Treehouse Masters
programme.desc: Swiss Family Surprise. Pete heads to Michigan to help a husband surprise his wife on their anniversary with a treehouse inspired by castaway classic Swiss Family Robinson. S5, Ep10

programme.title: Richard E. Grant's 7 Deadly Sins
programme.desc: Greed. Richard E Grant explores the evolutionary roots of greed - the act of taking too much. From hamsters, to baboons, do animals also display this seemingly human trait? S1, Ep7

programme.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier
programme.desc: Dangerous Waters. Eivin and Eve launch a risky clean-up operation to clear a tangle of old nets endangering fish in a nearby river. And, Atz Sr. goes on a solo hunt for moose. S9, Ep13

programme.title: Alaskan Bush People
programme.desc: Back To The Bush. The Wolfpack arrives on their new property in the most remote frontier of the lower 48. But the long winter wreaks havoc on the family's attempt to settle in. S4, Ep1

programme.title: Mountain Monsters
programme.desc: Lizard Demon of Wood County. Reports of alleged reptile-human hybrid roaming around West Virginia's Wood County are investigated by the team. Could there be a reptoid? S1, Ep6
